title: Each key handler acts on a DOM key event once
intent: Stop toggles flipping back and weapon keys firing twice when several keys arrive in one frame

attempts.failureReason: Phaser re-runs a step's whole key queue on every new key event, so with three or more events in one frame an earlier keydown was emitted again (5 emissions for 2 presses)

evidence.description: burst of key events toggles each setting once

constraints.statement: Register keys through ArenaScene.onKey, which remembers handled KeyboardEvents in a WeakSet
